headline: Ryanair CEO predicts European air fares could rise up to 20% in 2027
summary: Ryanair's chief executive predicts European air fares could surge by as much as 20% in 2027 as conflict in the Middle East pushes jet fuel costs higher.
why: Airlines are highly sensitive to jet fuel price fluctuations, and unhedged carriers face margin pressures that are typically passed on to consumers via ticket prices.

impacts.name: Airlines
impacts.why: Rising fuel costs increase operating expenses, while higher ticket prices help offset margin compression.
